label: teo_convexo e epigrafo
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{teo_convexo e epigrafo}
	Let $U\subset \mathbb{V}$ be a non-empty convex set and $f:U \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$.
	Then $f$ is a convex function iff $\operatorname{epi} f$ is a convex subset of $\mathbb{V} \times \mathbb{R}$. 
	In particular, if $r\in \mathbb{R}$ and $f$ is a convex function, then 
	\begin{align}
		\nonumber
		\operatorname{epi} f \cap (\mathbb{V} \times \{r\}) & =\{(x,\tilde{r}) \in \mathbb{V} \times \mathbb{R}:f(x)\leq \tilde{r}, x\in U, \,\, \tilde{r} \in \mathbb{R} \} \cap (\mathbb{V} \times \{r\}) \\
		& = \{x \in \mathbb{V}:f(x) \leq r, x \in U\} \times \{r\} \nonumber \\
		& \cong \{x \in \mathbb{V}:f(x) \leq r, x \in U\}\nonumber 
	\end{align}
	are convex sets.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md: See Section 4 of \cite{Rockafellar}.

label: several uniform convergences
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{several uniform convergences}
	Let $(M,F)$ be a Finsler manifold and $F_\varepsilon:TM \rightarrow [0,\infty)$ be a mollifier smoothing of $F$ as defined in \eqref{F epsilon definida em TM}.
	Let $U$ be an open subset of $M$ as defined in (\ref{definindo U}) and $(\operatorname{\boldsymbol{x}}, \operatorname{\boldsymbol{y}}) = ((x^i), (y^i))$ the coordinate system on $TU$ as defined in (\ref{sistema de coordenadas x,y}). For every multi-index $\alpha$, the following geometrical objects of $(M,F_\varepsilon)$ converges uniformly to the respective objects of $(M,F)$ on compact subsets of $TU\backslash 0$:
	\begin{align}
		D^\alpha (g_\varepsilon)_{ij} & \rightarrow D^\alpha g_{ij}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (g_\varepsilon)^{ij} & \rightarrow D^\alpha g^{ij}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (\ell_\varepsilon)^i & \rightarrow D^\alpha \ell^i. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (A_\varepsilon)_{ijk} & \rightarrow D^\alpha A_{ijk}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (C_\varepsilon)_{ijk} & \rightarrow D^\alpha C_{ijk}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (\gamma_\varepsilon)^i{}_{jk} & \rightarrow D^\alpha \gamma^i{}_{jk}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (N_\varepsilon)^i{}_j & \rightarrow D^\alpha N^i{}_j. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (\Gamma_\varepsilon)^i{}_{jk} & \rightarrow D^\alpha \Gamma^i{}_{jk}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (\sigma_\varepsilon)^i & \rightarrow D^\alpha \sigma^i. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (\dot A_\varepsilon)^i{}_{jk} & \rightarrow D^\alpha \dot A^i{}_{jk}. \nonumber \\
		D^\alpha (R_\varepsilon)_{jikl} & \rightarrow D^\alpha R_{jikl}. \nonumber
	\end{align}
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md: See Theorem 6 and Lemma 12 of \cite{Fukuoka-Setti}.

label: convergencia uniforme Chern
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{convergencia uniforme Chern}
	Let $(M,F)$ be a Finsler manifold and let $F_\varepsilon$ be a mollifier smoothing of $F$. 
	Let $X$ be an arbitrary section into $TM\backslash 0$ and $E$ be an arbitrary section into $\pi^*TM$.
	Then $\left( \nabla_\varepsilon \right)_X E$
	converges uniformly to $\nabla_X E$ on compact subsets $K_{TM \setminus 0}$ of $TM\setminus 0$.
	The statement also holds for the Cartan connection, Hashiguchi connection and Berwald connection.
